name: Weird Is Normal ~Delivery~
source:
Johnson is in the middle of a frustrating raid with people that apparently never had played anything other than Tetris before. He needs something with a lot of cheese and and ham: pizza.
But surely the whole raid would fall apart entirely the second he leaves, so how does he get his pizza instead? Maybe he knows someone that may be of help?
But will they help willingly?

[From [url=https://moonbyte.itch.io/weird-is-normal-delivery]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
约翰逊正和一群显然除了《俄罗斯方块》外什么都没玩过的人进行令人沮丧的突袭。他需要一些有大量奶酪和火腿的东西：披萨。
但他一离开，整场突袭肯定会彻底崩溃，所以他该怎样拿到披萨？也许他认识能帮忙的人？
不过，对方会愿意帮忙吗？

[来源：[url=https://moonbyte.itch.io/weird-is-normal-delivery]itch.io[/url]]
